# ProjectBase — AI Agent & LLM Integration Reference

> Ultra-lightweight, high-performance Plane & Linear alternative for multi-project Kanban and sprint management.
> Host: http://localhost:8120 (Tailscale LAN) / http://localhost:8120
> Engine: PocketBase (Go + SQLite) + Zero-Build Vue 3 UI
> OpenAPI Spec: http://localhost:8120/openapi.json
> Interactive Docs: http://localhost:8120/docs/

## Key Projects & Identifiers
- PB: ProjectBase Core (Plane & Linear alternative with Vue 3 + PocketBase)
- LOAD: LoadETA (Real-time freight dispatching & driver ETA optimization)
- IBR: iBrowse (Headless browser automation, E2E QA, & console audits on :3000)
- HOME: Homelab Infrastructure (Ubuntu server, Tailscale mesh, & monitoring)
- OMNI: OmniRoute (AI Gateway & multi-model proxy on :20128)
- MEM: Memrize (Unified memory layer & knowledge graph)

## Agent FastMCP Setup
Add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json or ~/.flomaster/config.json:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "projectbase": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["run", "/data/projects/projectbase/scripts/mcp_server.py"],
      "env": { "PROJECTBASE_URL": "http://localhost:8120" }
    }
  }
}

## Core Agent Tools & Endpoints
   MCP tool for autonomous dispatch (equivalent of endpoint 5c below): claims
   the issue (status → in_progress, assignee → target agent) and posts the
   audit comment. Preferred over raw REST when using the FastMCP server.
1. Quick Task Creation: POST /api/projectbase/quick-task {"project_key":"LOAD","title":"Task name","status":"todo","priority":"high"}
2. Query Issues: GET /api/collections/issues/records?filter=(project='<ID>')&sort=order,-created
3. Update Status: PATCH /api/collections/issues/records/<ID> {"status":"in_progress" | "done"}
4. Append Audit Comment: POST /api/collections/comments/records {"issue":"<ID>","author":"Flomaster Agent","author_type":"agent","content":"Summary"}
5. Global Issue Search (cross-project): GET /api/projectbase/search?q=<query>&limit=<n> — searches title, identifier, status, and priority across every project the user can see. Each result carries { id, identifier, title, status, priority, project_id, project_name, project_identifier, project_color }.
5b. Import Issues:
   - CSV:    POST /api/projectbase/import/csv      {"project_id":"<ID>","rows":[{title,description?,status?,priority?,assignee?,due_date?,estimate?,labels?,source_key?}]}
   - GitHub: POST /api/projectbase/import/github  {"project_id":"<ID>","repo":"owner/name","token?":"...","state?":"all","max_issues?":1000}
   - Linear: POST /api/projectbase/import/linear  {"project_id":"<ID>","rows":[{ID,Title,Status,Priority,Labels,Assignee,"Due Date",Estimate,Description}]} OR {"project_id":"<ID>","csv":"<raw Linear workspace CSV export>"}
   - Plane:  POST /api/projectbase/import/plane   {"project_id":"<ID>","rows":[{Name,State,Priority,Labels,Assignees,"Start Date","Target Date",Estimate,Description}]} OR {"project_id":"<ID>","csv":"<raw Plane workspace CSV export>"}
   Each is idempotent (deduped by source_metadata.source_key) and returns { imported, skipped, total, errors }.
6. Export Issues (data portability — mirrors the importer columns so an exported
   file can be re-imported into another ProjectBase or Linear/Plane/Trello):
   - CSV:  GET /api/projectbase/export/csv?project=<ID>   (attachment download)
   - JSON: GET /api/projectbase/export/json?project=<ID>  (machine-readable)
   - ICS:  GET /api/projectbase/export/ics?project=<ID>   (RFC 5545 calendar feed — one VEVENT per issue due_date, cycle start/end, and milestone target_date; stable UIDs so Google/Apple/Thunderbird subscriptions dedupe across refreshes)
7. Notification Channel Settings (runtime-editable, self-hosted; admin/manager only):
   - Read:  GET /api/projectbase/notification-settings   → { discord_webhook_url, telegram_token, telegram_chat_id, generic_webhook_url }
   - Write: PUT /api/projectbase/notification-settings {"discord_webhook_url":"...","telegram_token":"...","telegram_chat_id":"...","generic_webhook_url":"..."}
   The dispatcher reads these DB values first and falls back to process env, so
   an agent/operator can change channels without restarting the binary.
8. Custom Fields (per-project, Linear-style properties):
   - List defs:    GET  /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields
   - Replace defs: PUT  /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields {"fields":[{"label":"Client","type":"text"},{"label":"Gate","type":"select","options":["P0","P1"]}]}
   - Validate:     POST /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields/validate {"values":{"client":"Acme"}}
   - Types: text | number | select | checkbox | date
8b. Labels (project-scoped colored tags referenced by the issues.labels string array):
   - List:   GET  /api/collections/labels/records?filter=(project='<ID>' || project='')  → { name, color, project }
   - Create: POST /api/collections/labels/records {"name":"bug","color":"#ef4444","project":"<ID>"}  (name+color required, ≤64 chars)
   - Apply:  PATCH /api/collections/issues/records/<ID> {"labels":["bug","auth"]}  (string array; also settable via bulk-update data.labels)
   The UI offers these as a picker (new-issue modal), quick-picks (drawer), colored chips (board/list), and a label filter (board/list, URL-synced ?label=).
9. Bulk Actions (board/list multi-select — up to 500 ids per call):
   - Bulk update: POST /api/projectbase/issues/bulk-update {"ids":["<ID>",...],"data":{"status":"in_progress","priority":"high","cycle":"<CYCLE_ID>"}}
     Allowed data fields: status, priority, cycle, milestone, estimate, start_date, due_date, labels, order + per-project custom_* fields. Returns {"updated":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.
   - Bulk delete: POST /api/projectbase/issues/bulk-delete {"ids":["<ID>",...]} (admin/manager only). Returns {"deleted":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.
10. Issue Relationships (blocks / blocked_by / related — reciprocal edges auto-mirrored):
   - List:   GET    /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations
   - Add:    POST   /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations {"issue":"<TARGET_ID>","type":"blocks"|"blocked_by"|"related"}
   - Remove: DELETE /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations {"issue":"<TARGET_ID>","type":"blocks"|"blocked_by"|"related"}
11. In-app Notifications (recipient-only inbox, hook-generated):
   - List:   GET  /api/collections/notifications/records?sort=-created
   - Read:   PATCH /api/collections/notifications/records/<ID> {"read":true}
   - Read all: POST /api/projectbase/notifications/read-all
12. Git Webhook Auto-Triage (CI-driven issue ingestion):
   - GitHub import: POST /api/projectbase/import/github {"project_id":"<ID>","repo":"org/name","token":"...","state":"open","max_issues":50}
     Authenticate with a Bearer token OR an X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC over the raw body
     (keyed by PROJECTBASE_GIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET; fail-closed when unset). Returns {"imported":N,...}.
13. Agent Sessions (live execution runs — the Sessions console):
   - List runs: GET /api/projectbase/agents → { agents, sessions } (PID, branch, files touched, transcript, tool calls)
   - Detail:    GET /api/projectbase/sessions/<SESSION_ID> (record id or session_id). Transcript lives at metadata.chat.
   - Copilot:   POST /api/projectbase/sessions/<SESSION_ID>/chat {"message":"...","attachments":["<ID>"],"attachment_payloads":[{"kind":"image|text","data":"..."}]} (≤8000 chars, ≤5 protected caller-owned files). This discusses captured run evidence; it does not control or message the underlying agent process.
     Appends the operator turn to metadata.chat and returns the assistant reply plus the full
     transcript. Replies come from the configured OmniRoute gateway; without one the message is
     queued and the response reports {"gateway_reached": false} rather than inventing an answer.
   - Sync:      POST /api/projectbase/agents/sync (rescan local agent stores)
13b. Saved Views (per-user named filter states for board/list):
   - List:   GET    /api/collections/saved_views/records (owner = caller; never shared)
   - Create: POST   /api/collections/saved_views/records {"name":"High prio bugs","query":"priority=high&label=bug","view":"board","project":"<ID>|''"}
     query keys whitelisted to q|priority|cycle|label; name ≤64 chars; view = board|list; owner filled server-side when omitted (spoofed owner rejected 400).
   - Update: PATCH  /api/collections/saved_views/records/<ID> (owner only)
   - Delete: DELETE /api/collections/saved_views/records/<ID> (owner or admin)
14. Full Agent Guide: GET /llms-full.txt
